name: Security of Network Services
description: Ensure that network services are identified, secured, and access to them is restricted using secure protocols.

name: Segregation in Networks
description: Ensure networks are segregated to reduce risks and limit the impact of security incidents.

name: Web Filtering
description: Ensure access to external websites is filtered to reduce exposure to malicious or inappropriate content.

name: Use of Cryptography
description: Ensure cryptographic controls are implemented to protect the confidentiality, integrity, and authenticity of information.
